name: Barbera d'Alba

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for red wine from Barbera, with up to 15% Nebbiolo allowed. Its zone covers Alba and many communes around it in Cuneo province, including Barbaresco, Neive and part of La Morra.
